select LEFT(FILE_NAME,33)+'20230801.CSV',file_name from d360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL

UPDATE d360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL SET FILE_NAME = LEFT(FILE_NAME,33)+'20230801.CSV'

select * from d360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESfull
select * from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEfull
select count(*) from d360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERfull where acid = 'PA4895410'

select EAB.ACID AS EAB_ACID
,CONVERT(DATE,EAB.EOD_DATE) AS EOD_DATE
,EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS TRAN_DATE_BAL
,EAB.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL AS VALUE_DATE_BAL
,EAB.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,CONVERT(DATE,EAB.END_EOD_DATE) AS END_EOD_DATE
,EAB.LCHG_USER_ID AS EAB_LCHG_USER_ID
,convert(datetime2, EAB.LCHG_TIME) AS EAB_LCHG_TIME
,EAB.RCRE_USER_ID AS EAB_RCRE_USER_ID
,convert(datetime2, EAB.RCRE_TIME) AS EAB_RCRE_TIME
,EAB.TS_CNT AS EAB_TS_CNT
,EAB.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS EAB_CRNCY_CODE
,EAB.BANK_ID AS EAB_BANK_ID
,LEFT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 5) AS EAB_BNK_CODE
,RIGHT(LEFT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS EAB_SOURCE_CODE
,EAB.FILE_NAME AS EAB_FILE_NAME
,CONVERT(DATE,EAB.insert_dttm) AS EAB_insert_dttm
,LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS EAB_Business_Date
from d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEfull eab where h = 'd'

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
